majorEvents.label: Genealogy
majorEvents.evidenceText: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

timeline.evidenceText: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
Anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel; and anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah to be prophet in your place.
So he departed from there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth. Elijah went over to him, and put his mantle on him.
But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of Yahweh here, that we may inquire of Yahweh by him?”
Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”
The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
and over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite; and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai;

definitions.short: Shaphat , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H8202. Shaphat שָׁפָט proper name, masculine ( he hath judged ); — usually Σαφατ[θ] : 1 father of Elilsha 1Kin 19:16 , 19 ; 2Kin 3:11 ; 6:31 . 2 prince of Simeon Num 13:5 . 3 grandson of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:22 . 4 Gaddite chief 1Chr 5:12 ( Σαβατ , Σαφαμ [ν] ). 5 herdsman of David 1Chr 27:29 ( Σωφαν , A Σωφατ , ᵐ5 L Σαφατ ).
